- Initial release of Editing Editor Generator (version 1.0.0).
- Edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB) into polished, export-ready videos.
- Automated cloud GPU video editing with result in 1–2 minutes; 1080p MP4 output.
- Simple authentication: anonymous users get 100 free credits by obtaining a NEMO_TOKEN.
- Upload, edit, preview, and export workflows supported; full session state management.
- Guidance for error codes, accepted formats, and recommended editing prompts included.
